sections.title: Prerequisite Review: Determinants as Area
lecture_lines: Determinants represent the signed area of a parallelogram.
Column vectors form the sides of this shape.
The area changes under linear transformations.
animations: Create a square with unit area. (Color: #FFFFFF)
Transform the square into a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/parallelogram.svg] using a transformation matrix. (Color: #00FF00)
Highlight the resulting area as the determinant value. (Color: #FF00FF)

sections.title: Framing the System as Column Vectors
lecture_lines: We represent Ax = b with column vectors.
Vectors act as axes for our target point.
We find weights to scale these vectors.
animations: Display the linear system as two distinct column vectors. (Color: #FFFFFF)
Extend vectors from the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/origin.svg] onto the plane. (Color: #00FFFF)
Form a parallelogram using these column vectors as sides. (Color: #FFFF00)

sections.title: Geometric Substitution (The 'Area-Ratio' Logic)
lecture_lines: Replace a column with the target vector b.
This creates a new, scaled parallelogram.
The ratio of areas reveals the weight.
Area ratio acts as a scalar.
This is the heart of Cramer's Rule.
animations: Display the initial [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/parallelogram.svg] and its calculated area. (Color: #FFFFFF)
Replace one [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/column.svg] with the target [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/vector.svg] b. (Color: #FF0000)
Calculate the new parallelogram area ratio. (Color: #00FF00)
Perform the same process for the second [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/vector.svg]. (Color: #00FF00)
Show the final geometric substitution relationship using the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/scalar.svg]. (Color: #FFFFFF)

sections.title: Putting it Together: The Visual Formula
lecture_lines: Cramer's formula is x equals ratio of determinants.
Area of Ax over Area of A.
Linear scaling isolates our scalar weights.
System solutions emerge from area ratios.
animations: Present x as the ratio of two specific determinants. (Color: #FFFFFF)
Show the numerator area over the denominator area. (Color: #FFFF00)
Label the formula components for clear identification. (Color: #FF00FF)
Highlight the numerator and denominator geometric regions. (Color: #00FFFF)
Display the completed visual formula layout. (Color: #FFFFFF)

sections.title: Summary & Intuition Check
lecture_lines: Cramer's Rule turns algebra into geometry.
It fails when vectors are collinear.
animations: Display core geometric concepts of Cramer's Rule using a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/protractor.svg]. (Color: #FFFFFF)
Finalize the formula and geometric condition using a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ruler.svg]. (Color: #00FF00)
